02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin

jobs.title: Entry level sales development representative
jobs.description:
Turn ambition into influence as an **Entry Level Sales Development Representative** at Clinical Management Consultants, building a high\-growth career where AI recruiting, healthcare sales, technology, marketing, and relationship development converge in downtown San Francisco.


As an Entry Level Sales Development Representative, ambitious professionals can build valuable expertise within Clinical Management Consultants, a modern, technology\-forward healthcare recruiting and staffing organization serving a national market. This opportunity offers exposure to healthcare sales, recruiting, digital marketing, business development, negotiation, client relationships, and AI\-assisted talent acquisition in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environment. Through AI\-powered workflows, data\-driven candidate sourcing, modern communication tools, measurable performance goals, and industry\-leading commission potential, each sales associate can expand a professional network while helping build and advance an AI\-first healthcare staffing CRM used to connect healthcare organizations with talented professionals.


The Entry Level Sales Development Representative operates at the center of an energetic, commission\-driven healthcare recruiting and outbound sales environment. Acting as a sales associate, recruiter, and business development representative, this professional will identify prospective candidates, source talent, market career opportunities, cultivate relationships with a professional healthcare audience, engage potential clients, follow up with leads, support negotiations, manage pipelines, and move searches toward successful placements. The role features an **industry\-leading AI\-first Healthcare Staffing CRM**, a **national recruitment marketplace**, **uncapped commissions**, and an **exceptional downtown San Francisco location**. AI\-assisted sourcing, candidate matching, recruiting automation, analytics, digital outreach, and intelligent workflows enhance human judgment and relationship\-building rather than replace them, allowing initiative, persistence, creativity, and measurable results to drive success.


Supported by experienced healthcare recruiters, account executives, recruiting leaders, marketing professionals, and technology\-enabled systems, the Entry Level Sales Development Representative will progressively take on greater responsibility across candidate development, client communication, lead generation, account development, market research, outreach, recruiting strategy, pipeline management, follow\-up, negotiation, relationship management, and placement activity. Practical training and day\-to\-day collaboration will help the business development representative develop transferable capabilities in healthcare staffing, sales, marketing, communication, AI recruiting technology, talent acquisition, and account management. Professionals who consistently produce results, understand healthcare markets, and earn the confidence of clients and candidates can broaden their responsibilities and create a compelling long\-term career trajectory.


The ideal Entry Level Sales Development Representative is ambitious, competitive, personable, articulate, persuasive, resilient, organized, and energized by meeting new people over the phone and through digital channels. Successful candidates will be comfortable pursuing measurable KPIs, balancing multiple priorities, learning new recruiting technology, and exploring how AI can improve sourcing and engagement. An understanding of nursing and hospital environments is valuable, but prior healthcare recruiting experience is not required; candidates from sales, staffing, account management, customer success, nursing, healthcare, business development, marketing, hospitality, professional services, or other relationship\-intensive fields can thrive through drive, curiosity, adaptability, and strong communication. This recruiter role is designed for someone pursuing a long\-term sales career—not an administrative HR position or a patient\-care assignment.


For an Entry Level Sales Development Representative, San Francisco, CA, is more than a workplace—it is a launchpad at the intersection of healthcare, AI, entrepreneurship, technology, and sales. The downtown location places the sales associate near innovative startups, established employers, healthcare organizations, universities, venture\-backed companies, and a deep network of ambitious professionals. Outside the office, San Francisco offers walkable neighborhoods, public transportation, waterfront recreation, parks, live music, professional sports, diverse cuisine, beaches, hiking, and cycling, with wine country, Lake Tahoe, and other Northern California destinations within reach for memorable weekends.


The Entry Level Sales Development Representative will receive competitive base compensation plus commission and bonus opportunity, with uncapped commissions connecting strong performance to meaningful earning potential. A comprehensive benefits package includes health coverage, retirement benefits, and a 401(k), supporting both immediate goals and long\-term career growth. Ambitious professionals ready to compete, connect, learn AI\-powered healthcare recruiting, and build a career with lasting momentum are encouraged to contact a Clinical Management Consultants recruiter and discover where this San Francisco sales opportunity could lead.

jobs.title: PiBnB Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
The PiBnB Logistics Coordinator is responsible for making the physical operations behind PiBnB run smoothly.


This person coordinates the many moving pieces required to get a PiBnB location ready for data collection: bookings, props, transportation, moving services, setup logistics, and ongoing site needs. They also help improve the systems and workflows that allow PiBnB to operate across more locations with less manual coordination.


This is a highly operational role. The ideal person is organized, responsive, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and good at building relationships with a wide range of people.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Bookings \& Site Coordination**

* Coordinate PiBnB bookings and scheduling.
* Communicate with hosts or site contacts before, during, and after bookings.
* Confirm access, timing, site requirements, and any special logistics.
* Maintain clear visibility into upcoming bookings and readiness.

**Props \& Site Readiness**

* Coordinate which props and equipment are needed at each location.
* Ensure props are staged, transported, and available before operations begin.
* Track missing, damaged, or misplaced items.
* Coordinate replenishment or replacement as needed.

**Transportation \& Vans**

* Coordinate vans and transportation required for each PiBnB deployment.
* Make sure vehicles are available at the right times and locations.
* Coordinate loading, unloading, and transportation of equipment and props.

**Moving \& Setup Services**

* Coordinate movers or other external service providers when needed.
* Provide clear instructions and expectations to vendors.
* Ensure locations are set up and reset appropriately.

**Operational Coordination**

* Act as a central point of coordination between operators, PiBnB hosts, vendors, drivers, props teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Identify logistics problems early and resolve them quickly.
* Communicate changes clearly when plans shift.

**Workflow Improvement**

* Build repeatable processes for recurring PiBnB logistics.
* Identify unnecessary manual work and opportunities to simplify coordination.
* Create checklists, trackers, templates, and other lightweight systems.
* Help PiBnB scale from individually coordinated deployments toward a reliable operating system.

**What We're Looking For**


The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

* **Organization:** Can keep many parallel details straight without dropping things.
* **Anticipation:** Thinks ahead about dependencies and potential failure modes.
* **Ownership:** Sees something that needs to happen and drives it to completion.
* **Prioritization:** Can distinguish an urgent blocker from something that can wait.
* **Communication:** Gives clear, concise updates and knows when to escalate.
* **Relationship building:** Works effectively with hosts, vendors, operators, and internal teams.
* **Adaptability:** Stays effective when plans change or unexpected problems arise.
* **Process orientation:** Doesn't just solve today's problem; looks for ways to make the next occurrence easier.
* **Attention to detail:** Checks that things are actually ready rather than assuming they are.
* **Service mindset:** Understands that good logistics makes everyone else's job easier.

The Administrative \& Program Coordinator works with senior leadership, Board members, funders, staff, vendors, older adult members, and community partners while maintaining a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.

TicketManager is hiring an Account Manager (AM) to own and grow a portfolio of customers, primarily consisting of accounts at approximately $2,500 MRR and below. jobs.title: Account Manager, Loyalty & Rewards
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**
---------------------


Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross\-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.


You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1\.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

**OUR ETHOS**
-------------


Operating at the epicenter of stablecoin innovation means moving fast and thinking globally. Our team reflects the diverse, international audiences we serve. We hire people who stay agile as the tide ebbs and flows, fix what's broken without waiting, chase trends before they peak, and remember to have fun through it all.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------


Uptop is one of the fastest\-growing pieces of Rain's platform. Our sports and entertainment partners use our rewards infrastructure to launch loyalty programs that change how their fans spend — combining everyday earn mechanics with merchant\-funded offers and premium redemption experiences that people actually want. Every one of those programs is a complex, cross\-functional launch: program design, offer and merchant supply, technical integration, compliance review, marketing coordination, and a partner team that is often building a loyalty program for the first time.


We're looking for an Account Manager to own that experience end to end. You will be the core interface between Rain and our partners from the moment a deal is signed — driving program design, coordinating launch, and then owning the relationship as the program scales. This is not a ticket\-queue support role. You will run complicated, multi\-month processes across many moving parts, hold the details that no one else is holding, and become the person our partners trust to get things done.


You'll own a portfolio of roughly five enterprise programs, with room to grow to ten as the business scales. This role is based in New York City, reports to the GMs of Rain's rewards business, and works closely with our Product, Engineering, BD, and Compliance teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**
---------------------

* Own the post\-sale relationship for a portfolio of loyalty and rewards partners, from kickoff through launch and into ongoing growth
* Translate a signed deal into a concrete program: earn structures, redemption catalogs, offer strategy, funding model, and success metrics
* Run launch as a project manager would — build the plan, drive the timeline, chase down blockers, and keep every stakeholder honest about what's due and when
* Serve as the single point of contact for partner teams, coordinating internally across Product, Engineering, BD, Compliance, and Marketing so partners get one clear answer instead of five
* Lead recurring business reviews: report on program performance, surface insights on spend lift and engagement, and recommend changes that make the program work harder
* Surface expansion opportunities within your accounts and hand them to BD with the context they need to run
* Maintain accurate account documentation, launch trackers, and internal reporting so the state of every program is legible at a glance
* Bring partner feedback back into Rain, and advocate for the roadmap changes that will make the next launch easier than the last

**WHAT YOU BRING:**
-------------------

* 3–7 years in Account Management, Customer Success, Implementation, Partner Management, or Program Management — ideally in sports, fintech, payments, or loyalty
* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programs to a deadline, with real ownership of the outcome
* Exceptional attention to detail; you are the person on the team who catches the thing everyone else missed
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, and genuine enjoyment of building relationships with partner teams
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and without a playbook — you'd rather build the process than wait for one
* Strong commercial instincts: you understand that a healthy account is one where the partner is getting measurable value
* Fluency with the tools of the job (CRM, project tracking, spreadsheets) and comfort getting into data to answer your own questions


You won't carry a sales quota — BD is owned by a dedicated team — but if you want to contribute to business development or product, there's plenty of room to do it.

**NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY:**
------------------------------------

* Direct experience with loyalty, rewards, card\-linked offers, or experiential/fan engagement programs
* Understanding of card payments economics — interchange, merchant funding, program P\&L
* Experience working with fintechs, neobanks, issuers, or card program managers
* Experience coordinating with brand, entertainment, or merchant partners
* Familiarity with stablecoins, crypto, or digital assets

**THINGS THAT ENABLE A FULFILLING, HEALTHY, AND HAPPY EXPERIENCE AT RAIN:**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Unlimited time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

**Flexible working** We support a flex

jobs.title: Treasury Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.



Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100\+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer\-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.



We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30\-year\-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.



We're a team of 170\+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.


Lithic's Treasury Operations team owns the movement of money across our card issuing infrastructure — network settlement, sponsor bank transfers, and the reconciliation that keeps it all provable. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who wants to learn the inner workings of payments and fintech infrastructure, not just observe them from a reporting layer.



You'll be running a critical, time\-sensitive engine every day — and at the same time, working alongside the Head of Treasury Operations to improve how that engine works as the function scales. You’ll also work cross\-functionally across a wide range of teams (Finance, Treasury Engineering, Risk, Analytics, Processing, Customer Success, Bank Operations) — this role sits at the center of a lot of different workflows, not off in a silo.


**What You'll Do**
------------------



Execution (50%)


* Own day\-to\-day execution of network settlement transfers (Mastercard, Visa) and related treasury transfers across sponsor banks
* Operate in a time\-sensitive environment where errors or delays have immediate downstream consequences
* Support reconciliation and ensure transfers tie out against expected activity
* Be a reliable, detail\-oriented operator of an existing process — accuracy and consistency matter as much as speed


Process Optimization (20%)


* Take existing workflows and make them better: fewer manual steps, stronger controls, cleaner audit trails
* Identify friction or risk in current processes and propose (and build) improvements
* Balance improvement work against the need for strong financial controls — nothing gets streamlined at the expense of auditability


Project Support (30%)


* Support the Head of Treasury Operations on larger initiatives as the function scales
* Contribute analysis, documentation, and execution support to new treasury infrastructure, reporting, or process builds


Ongoing


* Run ad hoc data analysis (SQL, Excel) to answer operational and financial questions on the fly
* Support downstream audit and reporting needs tied to settlement and reconciliation activity
* Be available outside normal business hours in rare emergency situations (e.g., a failed settlement or bank\-side issue)

**What You'll Learn**
---------------------



This role is a front\-row seat to the nuts and bolts of card issuing and payments infrastructure — network settlement mechanics, sponsor bank relationships, and the guts of how money actually moves through a modern fintech stack. You'll come out of this role with a depth of operational fintech knowledge that's hard to get anywhere else.


**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 2–4 years of relevant experience in treasury operations, funds transfer/money movement operations, cash management, or a closely adjacent operational finance role
* Experience with reconciliation and financial controls — you understand *why* the numbers need to tie out, not just how to make them tie out
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including comfort with (or willingness to learn) Google Apps Script for automating recurring workflows
* SQL proficiency for querying and validating data (we use Snowflake and Metabase); Python or other scripting is a plus, not a requirement
* Working comprehension of accounting concepts and financial operations / money movement (ACH, wires, card settlement, or similar) — you should be knowledgeable about how transfers and reconciliation tie back to the books
* Familiarity with Jira and Slack, or similar ticketing and collaboration tools, for tracking progress and coordinating across teams
* Comfort shifting flexibly between fixed process workflows and operating in an agile enrivonment (sprints, tickets, iterative process improvement)
* Interest in operating in a fast\-moving startup/fintech environment — this isn't a traditional back\-office treasury seat


The annual US salary range for this role is $80,000 \- $110,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.



This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

### **Benefits for Full\-Time US Employees:**


* Unlimited PTO
* 12\-weeks fully paid parental leave
* 4\-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5\-year anniversary)
* Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4\-weeks each year
* 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account
* Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match
* 401(k) match
* Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD


NYC\-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.



In\-office employees receive:


* Commuter benefit
* Catered lunch every Tuesday

Coordinate sample set\-up for product reviews and photoshoots. Partner with teams to ensure priority samples are available, staged, and ready for review.

Monitor third\-party shipping issues, lost shipments, delayed deliveries, and sample discrepancies.
* **Process Improvement \& Ownership**  

Identify opportunities to improve sample flow, organization, reporting, and communication. Bring forward ideas that increase efficiency, reduce sample loss, improve visibility, and strengthen Sample Operations as a reliable operational function.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
At Archive, we believe great products should live many lives. We build the technology that powers branded resale for some of the world's most beloved companies, including Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance, Dr. Martens, Peloton, and 50\+ others. Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.


The secondhand market is growing three times faster than traditional retail and is projected to reach $350B globally by 2028\. We're building the infrastructure behind that shift, helping brands turn resale into a meaningful part of their business and helping consumers rethink how they shop. If you're excited to change consumer behavior for the better, we'd love to meet you.

**About the role…**
-------------------


We're looking for a Business Development Representative who will both personally drive meaningful new pipeline *and* work with the broader team to level up how our entire outbound engine runs. This is a rare blend of individual contribution and process innovation.


You'll carry a personal pipeline target and partner closely across our sales and marketing teams. Together, you will own our top\-of\-funnel strategy and goals. Just as importantly, you'll partner to reinvent how we prospect — bringing an AI\-first mindset to sourcing, research, messaging, and workflow so that our small team punches well above its weight. This role reports directly to the Head of Marketing \& RevOps and is fully remote, if located in Austin \- we would expect you to come into our local coworking space 2 days a week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


This is the top of Archive's revenue engine. Every new logo we win — Lululemon, The North Face, New Balance — started with someone opening the door. That's this role.

* **Own the number.** You'll carry a personal pipeline generation target and be jointly accountable with the team for the net new number overall — forecasting opportunity creation, calling it accurately, and keeping the team on pace.
* **Build relationships with world\-class brands.** You'll research, account plan, and open opportunities with an elite list of household names. We value depth over breadth: roughly 30 accounts a quarter, worked properly, beats a thousand sprayed sequences.
* **Rebuild how we prospect, with AI.** This is the half of the job that compounds. You'll use AI and LLMs to redesign how we source, research, prioritize, personalize, and sequence — testing, iterating, and doubling down on what works. The goal isn't efficiency, it's leverage: a motion where you and the team put out the quality *and* the volume of a 3\+ person BDR team, without losing the craft that makes outreach actually convert.
* **Own the data and inform the stack.** Everything tracked, documented, and flowing cleanly between tools. You'll demo new tools and make the call on what we add, consolidate, or cut. There are more tools than ever before, but the real magic is in your ability to creatively leverage these tools and know when to just show up as a human.
* **Partner across the go\-to\-market team.** You'll work directly with the sales and marketing team as well as partnering with other teams across the org— refining the end\-to\-end sales process, building the prospecting workflow, and making sure the outreach engine is aimed at the right brands and capturing the right signals.
* **Build momentum.** You'll help shape our sales norms as the team grows, and take on — or invent — the projects that help Archive grow. It's normal to have never built a motion like this before, you won’t be building it alone and we care more that you want to.

**Requirements**
----------------

* You have 1\-2\+ years of sales development / outbound experience
* You've personally been a top\-performing BDR/SDR and still love the craft of opening opportunities — you take pride in crafting campaigns and writing emails that convert.
* You have strong writing skills and can generate compelling, high\-converting sales emails.
* You’re collaborative and want to be part of an excellent team, hold yourself and others to high standards, and are looking for the right role to advance your career.
* You're AI\-native. You don't just use ChatGPT to draft emails — you think in systems, and you have a strong point of view on how AI can be woven through the entire outreach landscape to make a tiny team output like a much larger one. You're excited to dig deeper and learn how to optimize with AI.
* You're proficient with sales and automation tools like HubSpot and Apollo, and you believe in continuous process improvement.
* You have a competitive nature and a growth mindset, and are willing to do hard things, viewing challenges as opportunities for development. Presenting in front of executives, cold calling, knocking on doors, finding the right way to get in front of the right people.
* You're organized and data\-driven, comfortable owning a number.
* You care about sustainability and believe in the power of secondhand shopping to transform the industry.
* Ideally you are in Austin and excited to be in person in our coworking space 2\+ days a week.

**Bonus requirements**
----------------------

* Events experience (in\-person networking)
* Writing experience (blogs, content, etc)

**The expected annual base salary range for this position is $60K\- $80K, USD, plus additional variable compensation through an On\-Target Earnings (OTE) structure.** Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren't limited to) such as role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible for equity as well, and all employees are eligible for a full benefits package including employee and dependent healthcare and 401(k) enrollment.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for supporting customers in three key areas:

* **Issue Resolution:** Coordinate the investigation and resolution of software and system issues.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Gather customer feedback, identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities, and help translate them into actions that improve EasyWMS and the customer experience.


The TAM acts as the main communication link between the customer, the U.S. support team, and technical teams in Spain.


**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Customer Support \& Incident Management**

* Attend the **Technical Support Hotline** when customers need to speak directly with the Mecalux support team.
* Understand the customer's issue and ensure that a support ticket is properly created.
* Troubleshoot low\-severity issues when possible.
* Escalate higher\-severity issues to the appropriate technical team and ensure someone is actively working on the problem.
* Monitor open tickets and ensure issues are progressing according to the applicable SLA.
* Help prioritize issues based on their impact on warehouse operations.
* Conduct recurring meetings with customers to review open issues and their progress.
* Act as the main communication contact during high\-priority incidents.
* Provide clear and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders during active incidents.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, root causes, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate communication between U.S. customers and technical resources in Spain to ensure clear and effective communication.

**2\. Technical Support Coordination**

* Coordinate software patches, configuration changes, system updates, and other technical activities.
* Help investigate recurring software or service failures and identify their root causes.
* Identify process changes that can prevent issues from recurring or reduce their impact when they cannot be completely avoided.
* Follow up on corrective actions until they are fully implemented.

**3\. Change Request Management**

* Manage the implementation of customer Change Requests.
* Coordinate the administrative process in SAP.
* Schedule work with internal technical teams and customers.
* Follow up on implementation progress.
* Evaluate the impact of changes after implementation.

**4\. Customer Relationship \& Continuous Improvement**


Through regular customer meetings, ticket analysis, and operational feedback:

* Monitor customer satisfaction with EasyWMS.
* Monitor customer satisfaction with the Remote Support service.
* Identify recurring issues and support trends.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer processes and the EasyWMS product.
* Gather customer feedback and translate it into actionable product improvement opportunities.
* Bachelor's degree in **Information Technology, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field**.
* **English:** At least C2 proficiency.
* **Spanish:** At least C2 proficiency.
* Good understanding of **warehouse operations and distribution center processes**.
* Professional communication skills, with a customer\-focused mindset.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to multi\-task and problem\-solve in high\-pressure situations
* Previous related experience is preferred.
* Previous exposure to WMS, ERP, or supply chain software is preferred.
* Knowledge of SQL and database troubleshooting is preferred.
* Previous exposure to Windows Server and Virtualized Server environments is preferred.
* ERP, APIs and middleware integrations is preferred.
* Previous exposure to ticketing systems such as Jira, Zendesk, or ServiceNow is preferred.

**About the Role**
------------------


At **Exploring Graphics**, a division of **Exploring, LLC**, every project is unique. As an **Account Manager**, you are the primary point of contact for your clients, responsible for managing projects from concept through final installation. You serve as the bridge between clients, sales, design, production, shipping, and installation teams, ensuring every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.


This is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused position that requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Starting Your Day**
---------------------


You begin your morning by reviewing project schedules, production updates, installation timelines, and customer communications. With several projects in different stages of production, you prioritize your workload and identify any issues that require immediate attention.


You check emails, review artwork approvals, monitor shipping schedules, and prepare for customer meetings. Every day starts with a clear understanding of what needs to happen to keep projects moving forward.

**Building Customer Relationships**
-----------------------------------


Throughout the day, you communicate with customers, exhibit houses, marketing teams, event coordinators, and internal departments to ensure everyone is aligned.


You answer questions, provide project updates, review specifications, coordinate schedules, and help customers navigate changes throughout the project lifecycle.


Success in this role is built on trust, responsiveness, and the ability to consistently exceed customer expectations.

---------------------


As projects move through production, you coordinate with:

* Graphic Production
* Print Operators
* Finishing
* Shipping \& Logistics
* Installation Teams
* Purchasing
* Project Management
* Sales


You verify artwork approvals, review production schedules, coordinate freight, and ensure materials arrive where they need to be—on time and ready for installation.


Every detail matters because your planning directly impacts the success of customer events.

-------------------


Trade shows and events operate on strict deadlines. Priorities change quickly, and unexpected challenges can arise.


You proactively identify potential issues before they become problems, whether it's adjusting production schedules, expediting shipments, coordinating reprints, or communicating schedule changes with customers.


Your ability to stay organized and remain calm under pressure is one of your greatest strengths.

At Exploring Graphics, no one succeeds alone.


You work closely with production, operations, purchasing, logistics, installers, and sales to ensure projects are completed accurately and efficiently.


Daily communication and teamwork are essential to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

**Business Growth**
-------------------


While providing outstanding customer service, you also look for opportunities to grow customer relationships.


You identify additional products and services that support your clients' marketing objectives and event needs while helping build long\-term partnerships.

**Wrapping Up**
---------------


Before ending the day, you update project notes, document customer communications, confirm production milestones, and prepare for the next day's priorities.


You leave knowing your work helped create graphics, displays, exhibits, and branded environments that will be seen by thousands of people across the country.

jobs.description:
The DERMS Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). This newly created position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation, laying the groundwork for the expansion of energy management within the distribution system. The DERMS Operations Specialist is responsible for the real\-time and near\-real\-time operational integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) on the electric distribution system. This role ensures DERs are operated safely, reliably, and in compliance with grid constraints, using DERMS and related advanced distribution applications. The specialist serves as a technical bridge between distribution system operators, planning, IT/OT systems, and DER programs.


Currently, DERMS is in Phase I of implementation, focusing on visibility of the distribution system. During this stage, the DERMS Operations Specialist will maintain system awareness, monitor distributed resources, and evaluate load and generation forecasts. As the program prepares for Phase II, which includes system optimization and dispatch, the DERMS Operations Specialist will contribute to the development of user interfaces, tools, and processes necessary for seamless and reliable DERMS operations. As new distributed resources are integrated, the specialist will ensure communication paths are established for real\-time monitoring and dispatch.


This role will initially follow a hybrid work schedule, with four days per week, Monday through Thursday, at the office located at 241 Ralph McGill.

The **Manager\-Field Marketing** develops and executes local marketing strategies that support revenue growth, client engagement, and business objectives across two auction locations. This role leads a team of two marketing professionals, partners closely with auction leadership, sales teams and serves as the voice of marketing within the business.  

  

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, strategic thinking, relationship\-building skills, and the ability to lead teams in a fast\-paced, highly visible environment. Candidates must be comfortable balancing strategy and execution while fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.  

  

This position reports to the Senior Manager\-Marketing and maintains a strong partnership with auction leadership.  

  

**Primary Responsibilities**  

* Develop and execute local marketing strategies aligned with auction, regional, and corporate business goals.
* Partner with auction leadership, field sales, and marketing stakeholders to drive client engagement, revenue growth and business results.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of marketing professionals through regular feedback, performance management and career development.
* Build strong relationships with key dealer and commercial clients while serving as a trusted marketing advisor.
* Translate business goals into actionable marketing plans and ensure successful execution across assigned locations.
* Use data, KPIs, and market insights to evaluate performance, optimize campaigns, and identify new opportunities.
* Drive consistency, process discipline, accountability, and operational excellence across marketing activities.
* Champion adoption of AI\-enabled tools, technologies, and best practices to improve efficiency, collaboration, and decision making.
* Manage marketing budgets and prioritize resources to maximize business impact and return on investment.
* Collaborate with creative, digital, and corporate marketing teams to ensure alignment with brand standards and strategic priorities.
* Partner with auction leadership to deliver exceptional sale\-day experiences, events, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Regularly travel between assigned locations.

  

**Required Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in a related discipline and 6 years experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and 4 years experience; a Ph.D. and 1 year experience in a related field; or 10 years experience in a related field
* 1\+ year(s) of direct people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and employee development.
* Experience building strong client and stakeholder relationships.
* Strong communication, presentation, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience using data and analytics to drive business decisions and marketing performance.
* Experience managing B2B client relationships and marketing programs.
* Experience managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adapt to changing business needs and industry dynamics.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, Word and Copilot.
* Ability to work onsite and engage directly with business partners, clients, and team members.
* Physical demands: Ability to sit or stand for prolonged periods of time. Vision abilities required include close, distance, color and depth perception. Ability to lift up to 25 pounds. Stooping, bending, twisting, climbing stairs, pushing, pulling, walking and reaching may be required.
* Work environment: Exposure to outdoor weather conditions as well as noise, dust and fumes in auction lanes.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 3\+ years of direct people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and employee development.
* Automotive or auction related experience.
* Experience with budget and financial management.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

  

USD 89,400\.00 \- 134,000\.00 per year  

  

**Compensation:**  

  

Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $89,400\.00 \- $134,000\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.  

  

**Benefits:**  

  

The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.  

  

Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship.  

  

EOE, including disability/vets

jobs.title: Pricing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
* Peachtree Corners, GA, United States / Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance \& Accounting
* JOB218596


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Specialist to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in either our Sunnyvale, CA or Peachtree Corners, GA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process auto

As the Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, you will support our growing services practice **.** The Practice delivers focused Agentic Services with the client's chosen OpenAI technologies, bringing industry depth and technical rigor to every phase of their AI journey including ChatGPT Enterprise, domain\-based customer models, agentic workflows and frontier platforms as well as change management and cybersecurity.  

  

Business Development Representatives are members of a dynamic, co\-evolving community of individuals working together with Deloitte's Sales and Growth Platform organizations to create and capture value and position Deloitte's capabilities and expertise in the market across various technology platforms.  

  

This is a Deloitte business\-development role focused on identifying and shaping opportunities for permissible Deloitte professional services. It is not an OpenAI product\-sales, reseller, referral, channel, or joint\-selling role. The role operates through Deloitte account and pursuit teams and is independent from the operations from OpenAI.  

  

Deloitte can advise and implement OpenAI products and interact with OpenAI in a manner that adheres to the independence guardrails, consistent with the rules and policies of the Securities Exchange Commission.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 9/30/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative for the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice team, you will be responsible for:
  

* **Identifying top\-of\-funnel opportunities:** Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders across Deloitte account teams and the Practice. Participate in internal only account planning activities by identifying relevant opportunities while ensuring adherence with independence guidelines.
* **Building awareness of the practice:** Creating market and internal awareness of the Practice to source new leads and opportunities. Additionally, generate awareness and educate Deloitte practitioners on Deloitte's services capabilities while ensuring we are adhering to Independence Guidelines.
* **Support client relevant deliverables:** Assist Deloitte's go\-to\-market team in creating new industry or domain specific, success stories, quals and proposal submissions, focusing on Deloitte professional services. Initiate the development and execution of lead generation field events, collateral, case studies, videos, or white papers. Coordinate with account teams for follow\-ups and drive deal progression.
* **Partner across sales teams:** Engage with Deloitte internal sales teams to explore opportunities for cross\-sell/upsell across technologies, platforms, offerings (e.g. AI\&E, Human Capital, Customer etc.) and domains (Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, HR etc.). Demonstrate comprehensive Industry sales coverage by generating new leads for sales executives.

  

**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

This role sits within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, under the Technology Relationships segment of Deloitte's Growth Platforms organization.  

  

Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice is geared around advising, implementing, and operating solutions for our clients who have selected OpenAI's GenAI models (e.g. Enterprise, Codex, etc.). The practice offers solution engineering, technical enablement, and domain expertise to help organizations and Deloitte practitioners achieve their goals with artificial intelligence. We deliver hands\-on technical training, custom AI solutions, reusable tools, accelerators, and industry\-focused knowledge to address real\-world challenges, equipping both clients and Deloitte professionals with best practices, practical guidance, and collaborative networks to identify valuable AI opportunities and drive measurable outcomes.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 5\+ years' experience in Technology or relevant Industry markets with an emphasis on significant business development and client relationship experience.
* Fluency in Cloud Analytics/Data Platforms and Agentic/AI technologies.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  

Preferred:
  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited school or university.
* Expert level understanding of Cloud marketplace and strong command on market messaging and presence for Cloud\-oriented professional services firms.
* Experience executing sales and capturing strategies and initiatives to transition underperforming IT organizations and programs to become customer\-centric and operate a service delivery model.
* Deep technical understanding of Cloud technologies e.g. Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI and other Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) as well as a demonstrated understanding of modern approaches to Cloud infrastructure, software development, and legacy systems modernization.
* Work with account and pursuit teams to architect large, complex capture efforts with teaming partners, staff, and practice leadership at all stages of the capture lifecycle.
* Prior experience working with major industries/vertical markets and experience with OpenAI technologies or comparable GenAI platforms is a plus.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two\-sided commerce network: 15,000\+ brands and 3,500\+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Chicago location\*\***



The **Project Coordinator** supports the delivery of product content and data across recipient programs. This role manages workflows, monitors progress, maintains accurate program information, and helps resolve day\-to\-day issues that may affect content delivery or publication outcomes.



Working closely with Program Management, Customer Success, Operations, Product, Engineering, suppliers, and other stakeholders, the Project Coordinator provides hands\-on operational support for strategic programs. The role is well suited for someone who is highly organized, detail oriented, comfortable working with data, and motivated to improve the customer and recipient experience.


**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**


* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities, workflows, milestones, and deliverables across assigned recipient and retailer programs.
* Support strategic programs by monitoring product content as it moves through Syndigo workflows and identifying rejected, stalled, incomplete, or underperforming items.
* Partner with Program Managers, Customer Success Managers, Operations, Product, Engineering, suppliers, brands, and other stakeholders to help remove blockers and keep work progressing.
* Support Mandarin\-speaking suppliers and vendors participating in import vendor programs through clear business communication, onboarding, training, and ongoing operational coordination.
* Prepare and maintain weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports for recipient programs.
* Research and respond to customer and stakeholder requests in a timely manner, ensuring appropriate follow\-through and escalation when needed.
* Review data and program outputs for completeness, accuracy, and quality in accordance with documented requirements.
* Communicate program status, risks, delays, and dependencies clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Assist with additional operational, reporting, documentation, and program coordination tasks based on business priorities.


**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**


* 1 to 3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, customer success, program support, business analysis, or a related client\-facing role
* Experience in a software\-as\-a\-service, retail, e\-commerce, product content, data management, or syndication environment preferred
* Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English, with the ability to support business conversations, onboarding, and training for Mandarin\-speaking program participants
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools
* Experience with Jira, SharePoint, or similar operational tools is a plus
* Ability to work independently after training while remaining collaborative, responsive, and accountable for follow\-through
* Comfortable learning new software, workflows, and data processes

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**
----------------------------------



To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!



All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location**

GGP Chicago \- 350 N Orleans Street, Suite 300
**Business**

Headquartered in Chicago, IL, GGP is a leading retail real estate company with a portfolio of 95\+ high\-performing retail assets, encompassing over 95 million square feet of space across the United States. As an owner\-operator, we’re committed to creating vibrant destinations that bring people and brands together. With a team of 1,200\+ employees and a legacy of leadership in retail real estate, we’re shaping the future of the industry by delivering exceptional value to our partners and the communities we serve


If you’re ready to be a part of our team, we encourage you to apply.


**Job Description**

GGP has an immediate need for a **Marketing Coordinator** at our Chicago office.


Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Tenant Success, with a dotted line to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Marketing Coordinator is an hourly employee that serves as a vital resource for the Marketing team, providing tenant marketing coordination, marketing assistance, and administrative support.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Tenant Success support**
--------------------------


* Support the Sr. Manager, Tenant Success in the project management and implementation of prioritized tenant events and activations
* Coordinate the trafficking of retailer assets to support new store openings via digital channels across the portfolio
* Track all marketing, Strategic Partnership (GGP Media), and Property Management support for prioritized new store openings
* Assist with a variety of project management, event, and promotional program needs, including (but not limited to) developing sweepstakes rules with Legal as well as the sourcing and fulfillment of prizes or other event elements
* Develop and maintain the overall new store opening calendar and associated project plans and own overall successful execution of said plans

**Marketing support**
---------------------


* Manage budgeting tasks, including expense management, invoice processing, and monthly accruals for accounting
* Publish web and social content
* Collaborate with Legal and Risk Management on contractual agreements as needed
* Other assigned duties as needed

**Administrative for Head of Marketing**
----------------------------------------


* Assist in the daily business of department and team functions, such as coordinating meeting communication and flow, shipping and packaging, and assisting in team outings
* Support companywide cultural initiatives such as philanthropy events, monthly cultural programming, Leadership Conference, Town Halls, and Holiday Party
* Travel and expense management for Head of Marketing
* PowerPoint and QA support
* Other assigned duties as needed

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**
-------------


* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, real estate, hospitality, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

**Experience**
--------------


* Experience working in cross\-functional, stakeholder\-driven environments
* Experience with invoicing/contract management a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point)

**Skills**
----------


* Strong project management skills with strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong collaboration with a willingness to jump in and learn
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activations simultaneously
* Have the ability to wear multiple hats, roll up sleeves and demonstrate proactivity

**Physical Requirements \& Work Environment**
---------------------------------------------


* Standard business hours, Monday through Friday in\-office environment
* Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support business continuity during high\-volume tenant opening periods, activations, or time\-sensitive tenant needs

**Compensation**

* Salary type: Non\-Exempt
* Pay Frequency: Bi\-weekly
* Hourly Pay Range: $24\.00 \- $33\.65/hour
* Annual Bonus: 10%

**Benefit Information**

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, Dental and Vision beginning day 1
* 401(k) Company matching
* 401(k) Vests on Day 1
* Career development programs
* Charitable donation matching
* Generous paid time off (i.e., vacation, personal holidays, paid sick time)
* Paid Volunteer Hours
* Paid Parental Leave
* Family planning assistance including IVF, surrogacy, and adoption options
* Wellness and mental health resources
* Pet insurance offering
* Childcare Assistance
* Commuter benefits
* A culture on our values of Act with Integrity, Build Mutual Trust, Take Initiative and Win Together.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre\-screening will be contacted.
\#GGP

* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving skills.

jobs.description:
As the Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, you will support our growing services practice **.** The Practice delivers focused Agentic Services with the client's chosen OpenAI technologies, bringing industry depth and technical rigor to every phase of their AI journey including ChatGPT Enterprise, domain\-based customer models, agentic workflows and frontier platforms as well as change management and cybersecurity.  

  

Business Development Representatives are members of a dynamic, co\-evolving community of individuals working together with Deloitte's Sales and Growth Platform organizations to create and capture value and position Deloitte's capabilities and expertise in the market across various technology platforms.  

  

This is a Deloitte business\-development role focused on identifying and shaping opportunities for permissible Deloitte professional services. It is not an OpenAI product\-sales, reseller, referral, channel, or joint\-selling role. The role operates through Deloitte account and pursuit teams and is independent from the operations from OpenAI.  

  

Deloitte can advise and implement OpenAI products and interact with OpenAI in a manner that adheres to the independence guardrails, consistent with the rules and policies of the Securities Exchange Commission.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 9/30/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative for the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice team, you will be responsible for:
  

* **Identifying top\-of\-funnel opportunities:** Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders across Deloitte account teams and the Practice. Participate in internal only account planning activities by identifying relevant opportunities while ensuring adherence with independence guidelines.
* **Building awareness of the practice:** Creating market and internal awareness of the Practice to source new leads and opportunities. Additionally, generate awareness and educate Deloitte practitioners on Deloitte's services capabilities while ensuring we are adhering to Independence Guidelines.
* **Support client relevant deliverables:** Assist Deloitte's go\-to\-market team in creating new industry or domain specific, success stories, quals and proposal submissions, focusing on Deloitte professional services. Initiate the development and execution of lead generation field events, collateral, case studies, videos, or white papers. Coordinate with account teams for follow\-ups and drive deal progression.
* **Partner across sales teams:** Engage with Deloitte internal sales teams to explore opportunities for cross\-sell/upsell across technologies, platforms, offerings (e.g. AI\&E, Human Capital, Customer etc.) and domains (Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, HR etc.). Demonstrate comprehensive Industry sales coverage by generating new leads for sales executives.

  

**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

This role sits within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, under the Technology Relationships segment of Deloitte's Growth Platforms organization.  

  

Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice is geared around advising, implementing, and operating solutions for our clients who have selected OpenAI's GenAI models (e.g. Enterprise, Codex, etc.). The practice offers solution engineering, technical enablement, and domain expertise to help organizations and Deloitte practitioners achieve their goals with artificial intelligence. We deliver hands\-on technical training, custom AI solutions, reusable tools, accelerators, and industry\-focused knowledge to address real\-world challenges, equipping both clients and Deloitte professionals with best practices, practical guidance, and collaborative networks to identify valuable AI opportunities and drive measurable outcomes.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 5\+ years' experience in Technology or relevant Industry markets with an emphasis on significant business development and client relationship experience.
* Fluency in Cloud Analytics/Data Platforms and Agentic/AI technologies.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  

Preferred:
  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited school or university.
* Expert level understanding of Cloud marketplace and strong command on market messaging and presence for Cloud\-oriented professional services firms.
* Experience executing sales and capturing strategies and initiatives to transition underperforming IT organizations and programs to become customer\-centric and operate a service delivery model.
* Deep technical understanding of Cloud technologies e.g. Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI and other Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) as well as a demonstrated understanding of modern approaches to Cloud infrastructure, software development, and legacy systems modernization.
